new.brief: Creates an expression evaluating to the given `object` with a weak reference.
new.md:
Creates an expression evaluating to the given `object` with a weak reference.

Once the `object` is disposed, it will fail to evaluate.

This expression is meant to break reference cycles.

If you want to keep a reference to `object`, use [`ConstantExpression.new()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ConstantExpression#constructor:new).

get_object.brief: Gets the object that the expression evaluates to.
get_object.md: Gets the object that the expression evaluates to.
